notes: Rumble pack cut from 18 to 12: first-party N64 and DS Rumble Paks plus Sega's own Jump Pack (added from Sega Retro), with a few third-party Dreamcast packs (Performance, Pelican, Nyko, Joytech, Naki, Mad Catz Force Pack) and eWin for DS Lite; dropped ActiShock, Dragoncast Mega Jump Pak, EMS 4 Meg, Electronics Boutique Shaker Pack, Karat Shindou Tsuki, InterAct TremorPak duplicate, Nyko Hyper Pak Plus and maker-less Tremor Pak entries. Toys-to-Life portals, console keyboards and media add-ons unchanged apart from order and types. Tier shelf: no archetypes or brand entries.
